opening_situation: Hero is alone at the mill doorway, investigating beside the empty iron hook where the brass key is missing.

scenes.title: Brass key beneath a loose floorboard
scenes.node_description: The mill where the bridge Guard said the brass key would be, though its iron hook by the doorway stood empty.
scenes.obstacle: The brass key was missing from its iron hook beside the mill doorway.
scenes.outcome: Hero found the brass key beneath a loose floorboard.

scenes.title: Resting on the far bank at noon
scenes.node_description: The old bridge, barred by a locked iron gate that needed the brass key.
scenes.obstacle: The locked iron gate blocking the bridge.
scenes.approach: Hero unlocked the gate with the brass key.
scenes.outcome: The gate opened, and Hero crossed the bridge and rested on the far bank at noon.

endcap.end_situation: Hero is alone on the far bank of the old bridge, resting at noon.
